records.title: ProPortals Inventory System
records.summary: Built the inventory management system from concept to production and cleared webpack build issues that were blocking release, helping the team hit its deadline.
records.description: End-to-end delivery of core inventory management features, including technical triage on release-blocking build problems.

records.title: Regex Synthesis Engine
records.summary: Built a custom, industry-specific regex synthesis engine and library for textual data processing, inventory upload, and keyword harvesting.
records.description: Proprietary tooling to automate extraction and structuring of domain-specific inventory text in the lumber space.

records.title: Prisma Code Generators
records.summary: Built automated generators that synthesize class suites for Prisma models with class-validator, class-transformer, and Swagger integration.
records.description: Reduced repetitive implementation and maintenance overhead for DTOs and entity classes across services.
